title: Light and electrons as waves and particles
goals: LOPS FY8: the photon as a quantum of the electromagnetic radiation field

Clarification: the photon is treated through different models (state of the field, quantum of the field, quantum particle, mediator of an interaction); the Compton effect; the double-slit experiment with single photons and electrons. The de Broglie wavelength is not treated (teacher's decision 2026-11-03)
